commands.name: /about
commands.description: Show CLI version, system, and account info. Also copies it to the clipboard.

commands.name: /ask
commands.description: Toggle Ask mode for read-only questions

commands.name: /bedrock
commands.description: Configure Bedrock when the Bedrock feature is enabled

commands.name: /clear

commands.name: /config
commands.description: Configure CLI settings interactively

commands.name: /copy
commands.description: Copy a previous user message to the clipboard

commands.name: /copy-conversation-id
commands.description: Copy the current conversation ID to the clipboard

commands.name: /copy-request-id
commands.description: Copy the last request ID to the clipboard

commands.name: /debug
commands.description: Toggle Debug mode or submit a prompt in Debug mode

commands.name: /exit
commands.description: Exit

commands.name: /feedback
commands.description: Share feedback with the team

commands.name: /fork
commands.description: Fork the current chat into a new session

commands.name: /goal
commands.description: Give the agent a long-lived objective to work towards until it's fully complete. Rolling out.

commands.name: /help
commands.description: Show help. Use /help for command details.

commands.name: /line-numbers
commands.description: Toggle line numbers in code blocks

commands.name: /logout
commands.description: Sign out from Cursor

commands.name: /logs
commands.description: Show the debug log path and copy it to the clipboard

commands.name: /max-mode
commands.description: Toggle Max Mode on legacy request-based plans

commands.name: /mcp
commands.description: Manage MCP servers and list tools for a server

commands.name: /model
commands.description: Select a model. Press Tab to edit.

commands.description: Open the repository's Git root in Cursor. /cursor is an alias.

commands.name: /plan
commands.description: Switch to Plan mode, show the current plan, or submit a prompt in Plan mode

commands.name: /plugin
commands.description: Manage plugins and marketplaces

commands.name: /quit
commands.description: Exit

commands.description: Rename the current chat session

commands.name: /resume
commands.description: Open recent chats and resume one

commands.description: Jump back to a previous message

commands.description: Toggle Run Everything or show its status. /auto-run is an alias.

commands.name: /sandbox
commands.description: Configure sandbox mode and network access settings

commands.name: /setup-terminal
commands.description: Configure terminal newline keybindings. See Terminal setup.

commands.name: /shell
commands.description: Enter Shell Mode. /sh and /run are aliases.

commands.name: /show-thinking
commands.description: Toggle thinking block display

commands.description: Toggle terminal title status indicators

commands.description: Summarize the conversation to reduce context. /compress is an alias.

commands.description: Update Cursor Agent to the latest version

commands.name: /vim
commands.description: Toggle Vim keys
